question: What proteins are synthesized in the ribosomes attached to the endoplasmic reticulum ?:

options.opb: The proteins of the mitochondrial matrix.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: mRNA with a signal sequence -> binds to a ribosome on the endoplasmic reticulum -> protein synthesis occurs -> secretion proteins are synthesized -> 85% confidence. CHAIN: Signal recognition particle (SRP) recognizes the signal sequence -> guides the ribosome to the endoplasmic reticulum -> protein synthesis occurs -> secretion proteins are synthesized -> 85%
analysis: Proteins synthesized in the ribosomes attached to the endoplasmic reticulum are primarily involved in the process of secretion.
